hooks.text: How did armored French knights drown in Agincourt's mud?
At Agincourt, some French knights drowned in the mud.
In 1415, rain helped an outnumbered army defeat a larger one.

title: How Did Mud Trap French Knights at Agincourt?
description: Heavy rain turned Agincourt's plowed battlefield into thick mud. Some armored French knights drowned there as Henry V's outnumbered army won.
